metadata.description: s1d1-tantive as an Azure Container App in an existing Container Apps environment. The image is pulled from GHCR with the credentials given below; nothing is created besides the container app.
Name of the container app (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens).
Region of the container app; it must be the region of the environment.
Resource id of an existing Container Apps environment, e.g. /subscriptions/<id>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.App/managedEnvironments/<name>.
Image to run. One image per model variant: the tag ends with the variant (full-onnx-int8, small-onnx-int8, ...).
Registry that holds the image.
Registry user name (for GHCR, a GitHub user).
Registry password (for GHCR, a token with read:packages). Stored as a container app secret; never output.

Where the service is reachable. false = internal: only from inside the environment (its virtual network), the usual choice behind LiteLLM. true = external: public on the internet, then set apiKey. There is no default: choose.
vCPU per replica as a decimal string. 2.0 with 4Gi suits the full variant; 1.0 with 2Gi suits small.
Memory per replica. It must be a combination Container Apps accepts for the cpu (2.0 with 4Gi, 1.0 with 2Gi).
Minimum replicas. 1 keeps one replica warm: the model loads in a few seconds, so scale-from-zero would add that to the first request.
Maximum replicas.
Concurrent HTTP requests per replica above which a replica is added.

S1D1_TIERS: the tiers and their upper bounds, e.g. TRIVIAL=0.15,LOW=0.4,MEDIUM=0.7,HIGH=0.9,EXPERT=1.0. It must match the tier names LiteLLM sends, otherwise the service answers 422. There is no default: choose.
S1D1_FORMATS: the API formats to serve, comma-separated.
S1D1_DEADLINE_MS: a request that cannot be answered within this time is shed with a 503.
S1D1_API_KEY: the key callers must present. Empty = no key and no secret is created (fine for internal ingress; set it for external).
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT: OpenTelemetry collector for traces and metrics. Empty = no export.

Azure Files share that receives the captured prompts (docs/capture.md). Empty = no capture. When set, the share is mounted on /capture and S1D1_CAPTURE_DIR=/capture. The prompts are user data: enable with consent.
Storage account that holds the share. Required with captureShareName.
Key of that storage account. Stored by the Container Apps environment; never output. Required with captureShareName.

containers.name: tantive
containers.env: [concat(createArray(createObject('name', 'S1D1_TIERS', 'value', parameters('tiers')), createObject('name', 'S1D1_FORMATS', 'value', parameters('formats')), createObject('name', 'S1D1_DEADLINE_MS', 'value', string(parameters('deadlineMs')))), if(empty(parameters('apiKey')), createArray(), createArray(createObject('name', 'S1D1_API_KEY', 'secretRef', 's1d1-api-key'))), if(empty(parameters('otlpEndpoint')), createArray(), createArray(createObject('name', 'OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT', 'value', parameters('otlpEndpoint')))), if(empty(parameters('captureShareName')), createArray(), createArray(createObject('name', 'S1D1_CAPTURE_DIR', 'value', '/capture'))))]
